al-Marṣad

Sky Atlas

    Proposed Every claim here was compiled, mostly by an AI pass over Ibn Hishām's Sīra, and none has been reviewed by a scholar yet. Each record shows its source and its status.

    Drag to turn the sky, pinch or scroll to zoom, two fingers or Shift-drag to move. Tap a mark to open its record. Arrow keys turn, + and − zoom, Enter opens the mark at the centre, / finds a name, Esc steps back.

    Unpacking the graph…

    A sky of the Sīra, to be guided through

    The light at the centre is the Prophet ﷺ. The gold marks on the spiral are events, in the order Ibn Hishām's Sīra tells them. Around them are the people the text names, settled by their recorded links. Start the guided tour, or turn the sky and tap any mark.
